  Hosted

pub struct HostAllowance
  hosts: ::std::vec::Vec<::std::string::String>
pub struct PickRequest
  model: ::std::string::String
  fresh: bool
  allowed: ::std::option::Option<HostAllowance>
  profile: ::std::string::String
pub struct Caller
  user_description: ::std::string::String
  path_description: ::std::string::String
pub struct Observation
  caller: Caller
  took_ms: i64
  cache_age_ms: i64
pub struct ReasoningSupport
  efforts: ::std::vec::Vec<::std::string::String>
  budget: bool
  default_effort: ::std::option::Option<::std::string::String>
pub struct ModelCapabilities
  input: ::std::vec::Vec<::std::string::String>
  output: ::std::vec::Vec<::std::string::String>
  tools: ::std::option::Option<bool>
  structured_output: ::std::option::Option<bool>
  reasoning: ::std::option::Option<ReasoningSupport>
  extensions: ::std::vec::Vec<::std::string::String>
pub struct Alias
  host: ::std::string::String
  name: ::std::string::String
  resident: bool
  servable: bool
  hosted: bool
  profiles: ::std::vec::Vec<::std::string::String>
  held_in: ::std::vec::Vec<::std::string::String>
  context_length: i64
  effective_context_length: i64
  capabilities: ::std::option::Option<ModelCapabilities>
pub struct Component
  store: ::std::string::String
  role: ::std::string::String
  name: ::std::string::String
pub struct Engine
  id: ::std::string::String

  why: ::std::string::String
pub struct PickResult
  observation: Observation
  decision: Decision
pub struct OfferRequest
  profile: ::std::string::String
  placement: Placement
  reserve: i64
  fresh: bool
pub struct Offer

  observation: Observation

pub struct OfferObservation
  observation: Observation
  offers: ::std::vec::Vec<Offer>

pub struct ModalityPage
  outcome: ModalityOutcome

  next: ::std::string::String
  complete: bool
pub fn encode(v: &PickRequest) -> ::std::vec::Vec<u8>
pub struct Refusal
  word: &'static str
  offset: usize
pub fn decode(data: &[u8]) -> ::std::result::Result<PickRequest, Refusal>
pub trait JsonRecord: ::std::marker::Sized
  fn to_json(&self) -> ::std::vec::Vec<u8>
  fn from_json(data: &[u8]) -> ::std::result::Result<Self, Refusal>
pub use abstraction_frame::FrameTransport
pub struct ServiceError
  code: ::std::string::String
  message: ::std::string::String
pub enum CallError<E>
  Transport(E)
  Refusal(Refusal)
  Dispatch(&'static str)
  Service(ServiceError)
pub trait Router
  type Error
  fn modalities(&self, cursor: ::std::string::String, limit: i64) -> ::std::result::Result<ModalityPage, Self::Error>
  fn models(&self, fresh: bool) -> ::std::result::Result<ModelsSnapshot, Self::Error>
  fn hosts(&self, fresh: bool) -> ::std::result::Result<HostsSnapshot, Self::Error>
  fn pick(&self, request: PickRequest) -> ::std::result::Result<PickResult, Self::Error>
  fn offer(&self, request: OfferRequest) -> ::std::result::Result<OfferSnapshot, Self::Error>
  fn observe_offer(&self, request: OfferRequest, cursor: ::std::string::String, wait_ms: i64) -> ::std::result::Result<OfferObservation, Self::Error>
pub struct RouterClient<T>
  pub fn new(transport: T) -> Self
  pub fn transport(&self) -> &T
pub mod internal
  pub fn micros_timestamp(text: &str) -> bool
  pub fn wide_timestamp(text: &str) -> bool
